data: In the first matrix, to what word does the square in the bottom-right corner corresponds?

The question asks about the word corresponding to the square in the bottom-right corner of the first matrix. From the caption, we know that the dark blue squares represent areas of high similarity. In the top matrix, which is incorrectly predicted as similar, the bottom-right square is dark blue, indicating high similarity. By examining the horizontal axis, the word corresponding to this position is 'price'. Therefore, the square in the bottom-right corner of the first matrix corresponds to the word 'price'.
